verdict.rationale: Mintlify generates interactive API reference pages from OpenAPI specs with automatic endpoint pages, request builders, and navigation, which lets readers try real API calls directly in the docs (mintlify-docs-14). This is a well-documented first-party feature of the product's API-reference tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the request builder actually executes live calls against a real API and returns responses, and details on auth/try-it request execution mechanics.
